finite_candidate_design_catalog.reason: It discards range magnitudes after identifying strict local range maxima and measures only how broadly those volatility bursts are distributed over the fixed clock inside each half. This is a local-topology clock-dispersion mechanism, not range mass, range entropy, price direction, amount confirmation, a global extreme, or a return-variation ratio.
A count share would reopen the terminal amount local-peak-density statistic on another field and would not measure clock dispersion.
Magnitude weighting would overlap the frozen range clock center, participation entropy, profile similarity, and amount-alignment families.
Pooling clocks across lunch or forming a cross-lunch interval would change the fixed session topology and introduce another support choice.
Thresholds and confirmations would reopen terminal range, body, amount, volume, market, and path mechanisms and create a search catalog.
Subwindows, filters, ranks, regimes, neutralization, residualization, fitting, combinations, and models are outside the one-factor finite catalog.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_range_local_peak_clock_dispersion_236p
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Volatility bursts distributed across both continuous half-sessions indicate sustained, repeated information arrival rather than one isolated shock, and that distributed attention may continue from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: For each 120-bar half set q_i=ln(high_i/low_i). For interior i=1..118 mark a strict local peak when q_i>q_i-1 and q_i>q_i+1, map its clock to x_i=i/119, require at least two peaks in each half, compute the population variance of peak clocks separately in each half, and return their arithmetic mean.
selected_candidate.source_grid: Require the raw 09:30 row for immutable source identity; use exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, exclude 09:30, and detect local peaks separately inside each half.
selected_candidate.support: Require every selected high and low to be finite and strictly positive with high>=low, retain exact-zero ranges and exact ties as nonpeaks, and require at least two strict local peaks in each half without dropping or replacing any interior opportunity.
selected_candidate.valid_range: (0,0.25] under float64 population variance with no clipping or endpoint canonicalization
